mock_exam.composition_note_en: Part F allocates a fifth of a mock to earlier modules in the same phase. Module 9's only predecessor in Phase 4 is Module 8, whose files are not on disk — so the phase slice is three questions rather than six, and all three test the level 52-53 verb block that is independently attested. This is the same weighting decision taken in phase4_checkpoint.json and for the same reason. Three further phase questions should be added on merge.

questions.question: ने कब लगता है?
questions.question_read_as: ne kab lagtaa hai?
questions.explanation_en: Two conditions at once: the verb must be transitive and the tense perfective. Either alone is not enough.

questions.question: वह खा रहा है। ने क्यों नहीं?
questions.question_read_as: vah khaa rahaa hai. ne kyoṁ nahiiṁ?
questions.explanation_en: खाना is transitive, but the continuous is not perfective. Every other tense is ने-free.

questions.question: वह पढ़ता है। → परफ़ेक्टिव में लिखिए।
questions.question_read_as: vah paṛhtaa hai. → parfekṭiv meṁ likhie.
questions.explanation_en: पढ़ना is transitive, so वह becomes उसने. With no object stated the verb stays neutral.

questions.question: उसने रोटी ___ ।
questions.question_read_as: usne roṭii ___ .
questions.explanation_en: रोटी is feminine singular with no को, so the verb agrees with it.

questions.question: वह रोटियाँ खाता है। → परफ़ेक्टिव में लिखिए।
questions.question_read_as: vah roṭiyaaṁ khaataa hai. → parfekṭiv meṁ likhie.
questions.explanation_en: Feminine plural takes खाईं with the nasal, which learners routinely flatten to खाई.

questions.question: लड़की ने खाना खाया। क्रिया किससे मेल खाती है?
questions.question_read_as: laṛkii ne khaanaa khaayaa. kriyaa kisse mel khaatii hai?
questions.explanation_en: Once ने is present the subject is irrelevant, however visible she is in the sentence.

questions.question: कौन सा वाक्य ग़लत है?
questions.question_read_as: kaun saa vaakya ġalat hai?
questions.explanation_en: ने is a postposition, so लड़का must go oblique to लड़के in front of it.

questions.question: लड़की चाय पीती है। → परफ़ेक्टिव में लिखिए।
questions.question_read_as: laṛkii chaay piitii hai. → parfekṭiv meṁ likhie.
questions.explanation_en: पीना gives the one-syllable feminine पी. लड़की does not change because it is already in its oblique shape.

questions.question: तुम का ने वाला रूप क्या है?
questions.question_read_as: tum kaa ne vaalaa ruup kyaa hai?
questions.explanation_en: Pronouns fuse with ने. Noun subjects keep it separate.

questions.question: आप क्या कहते हैं? → परफ़ेक्टिव में लिखिए।
questions.question_read_as: aap kyaa kahte haiṁ? → parfekṭiv meṁ likhie.
questions.explanation_en: आपने, and क्या carries no gender so कहा stays neutral.

questions.question: यह का ने वाला रूप क्या है?
questions.question_read_as: yah kaa ne vaalaa ruup kyaa hai?
questions.explanation_en: यह goes oblique to इस exactly as वह goes to उस, and then fuses.

questions.question: कौन सा रूप मौजूद नहीं है?
questions.question_read_as: kaun saa ruup maujuud nahiiṁ hai?
questions.explanation_en: उनने is not a form. The plural is उन्होंने, irregular in the same way as इन्होंने.

questions.question: लोग कहते हैं। → परफ़ेक्टिव में लिखिए।
questions.question_read_as: log kahte haiṁ. → parfekṭiv meṁ likhie.
questions.explanation_en: Nouns go oblique and keep ने as a separate word. Only pronouns fuse.

questions.question: किस वाक्य में ने नहीं आएगा?
questions.question_read_as: kis vaakya meṁ ne nahiiṁ aaegaa?
questions.explanation_en: आना is intransitive, so the verb agrees with the subject in the ordinary way.

questions.question: कौन सा वाक्य ग़लत है?
questions.question_read_as: kaun saa vaakya ġalat hai?
questions.explanation_en: सोना is intransitive. Adding ने to an intransitive verb is the commonest over-correction once the rule has been learned.

questions.question: मुझे किताब मिली। ने क्यों नहीं?
questions.question_read_as: mujhe kitaab milii. ne kyoṁ nahiiṁ?
options: मिलना अकर्मक है — किताब आपके पास आती है
options_read_as: milnaa akarmak hai — kitaab aapke paas aatii hai
questions.explanation_en: It looks transitive in English and is not in Hindi. The verb agrees with किताब.

questions.question: कौन सी क्रिया ने नहीं लेती?
questions.question_read_as: kaun sii kriyaa ne nahiiṁ letii?
questions.explanation_en: बोलना, लाना and भूलना are the three transitive verbs that refuse it.

questions.question: कौन सा वाक्य ग़लत है?
questions.question_read_as: kaun saa vaakya ġalat hai?
questions.explanation_en: बोलना refuses ने even though कहना, which sits beside it in meaning, takes it.

questions.question: मैंने उसको देखा। क्रिया तटस्थ क्यों है?
questions.question_read_as: maiṁne usko dekhaa. kriyaa taṭasth kyoṁ hai?
options: को कर्म पर मेल रोक देता है
options_read_as: ko karm par mel rok detaa hai
questions.explanation_en: ने blocks the subject and को blocks the object, so nothing is left to agree with.

questions.question: मैं लड़की को बुलाता हूँ। → परफ़ेक्टिव में लिखिए।
questions.question_read_as: maiṁ laṛkii ko bulaataa huuṁ. → parfekṭiv meṁ likhie.
questions.explanation_en: को on a human object is obligatory, and it forces the neutral बुलाया despite लड़की being feminine.

questions.question: राम ने सीता को देखा। क्रिया किससे मेल खाती है?
questions.question_read_as: raam ne siitaa ko dekhaa. kriyaa kisse mel khaatii hai?
questions.explanation_en: Both slots are blocked, which is the proof that को is doing grammatical work rather than only marking a person.

questions.question: मैंने खाना खाया। → वर्तमान पूर्ण में लिखिए।
questions.question_read_as: maiṁne khaanaa khaayaa. → vartamaan puurṇ meṁ likhie.
questions.explanation_en: The auxiliary is added and nothing else moves — ने and the agreement both stay exactly as they were.

questions.question: उसने रोटी खाई। → भूतकालिक पूर्ण में लिखिए।
questions.question_read_as: usne roṭii khaaii. → bhuutkaalik puurṇ meṁ likhie.
questions.explanation_en: थी agrees with रोटी just as खाई does. Both parts follow the object.

questions.question: कौन सा वाक्य ग़लत है?
questions.question_read_as: kaun saa vaakya ġalat hai?
questions.explanation_en: किताबें is feminine plural, so both the participle and the auxiliary must be पढ़ी थीं.

questions.question: किस क्रिया के साथ सुनने वाला को लेता है?
questions.question_read_as: kis kriyaa ke saath sunne vaalaa ko letaa hai?
questions.explanation_en: उसने मुझे बताया, but उसने मुझसे कहा and उसने मुझसे पूछा. Module 13 level 19 returns to exactly this.

questions.question: मुझे मिल गया। इसका मतलब क्या है?
questions.question_read_as: mujhe mil gayaa. iskaa matlab kyaa hai?
questions.explanation_en: मिलना covers meeting a person and something becoming available to you, and neither sense takes ने.

questions.question: कौन सा वाक्य ग़लत है?
questions.question_read_as: kaun saa vaakya ġalat hai?
questions.explanation_en: बताना takes को. से belongs with कहना and पूछना, and there is no logic to it beyond the verbs themselves.

questions.question: कमरा + में = ?
questions.question_read_as: kamraa + meṁ = ?
questions.explanation_en: Any postposition forces the oblique — which is why ने does the same thing to लड़का and लोग.

questions.question: कौन सा शब्द स्त्रीलिंग है?
questions.question_read_as: kaun saa shabd striiliṁg hai?
questions.explanation_en: रोटी is feminine, which is the whole reason उसने रोटी खाई ends in -ई.

questions.question: कौन सा वाक्य ग़लत है?
questions.question_read_as: kaun saa vaakya ġalat hai?
questions.explanation_en: वह cannot stand before ने. It goes oblique to उस and then fuses, giving उसने.

review_flags: Q25, Q26 and Q27 draw on the Module 8 level 52-53 verb block (बताना, पूछना, मिलना, लाना), the only part of that module attested anywhere on disk. Their source_item_ids are empty. Re-point them and add three further phase questions once module08.json is merged, bringing the phase slice from three to the six that Part F's twenty per cent implies.

Q28, Q29 and Q30 are marked high_value and test the oblique case and gender agreement, which Module 9 depends on completely — ने forces the oblique and the object controls the verb. They have no source_item_ids because the modules that taught them are not on disk.
